india5.title: Delhi’s Hauz Rani, Lucknow’s Aliganj: The science of electrical fires in summer
india5.description: The Hauz Rani fire claimed 23 lives. Weeks later, another blaze in Lucknow’s Aliganj killed 15. Both are suspected to have been caused by electrical faults.

india5.title: Andy Burnham, 'King of the North', sworn in as MP hours after Starmer's exit; could become next UK PM as early as July
india5.description: Even though Keir Starmer set out a timeline for September while stepping down from PM office, Andy Burnham could also take office as early as July.

india5.title: 'Explosions to continue': After 6 UBT rebels shift to Shinde Sena, a warning 'for more'
india5.description: Shinde, in the presser, said the six MPs who joined his faction had done so voluntarily and without any pressure.

india5.title: Mamata back as TMC supremo? 'Replaced' by rebels, Didi named as party chief in fresh counter by her faction
india5.description: TMC rebel faction on Monday "replaced" Mamata Banerjee as the chairperson and elected senior MLA Arup Roy to the post.

india5.title: Who is George Kurian? BJP leader steps down as Union minister, President accepts resignation
india5.description: George Kurian's Rajya Sabha term had expired, following which he had to give up his ministerial post.

india5.title: India-US trade deal talks: India wants preferential access through US deal, says Piyush Goyal
india5.description: The talks are focused on finalising a new tariff architecture after the US Supreme Court on Feb 20 invalidated the 18% reciprocal duty on bulk of Indian goods.

india5.title: Proselytisation excluded from faith-based activities as govt amends FCRA rules
india5.description: The government has issued a series of amendments tightening the FCRA Rules for NGOs and associations in India on receiving and using foreign money

india5.title: Mumbai BMW crash survivor in coma booked after 2 die in 251 kmph highway horror
india5.description: An FIR has been registered against Angad Gill, the sole survivor of a tragic car crash that claimed two lives on the Mumbai-Vadodara highway.

india5.title: Mysuru bride-to-be, parents die by suicide days before wedding; cite harassment in note
india5.description: A suicide note was found at the deceased's house, which identified the person allegedly responsible for their deaths and cited harassment as the reason.

india5.title: NEET-UG re-exam cheating racket busted in Bihar: 30 arrested, including 9 impersonators
india5.description: Among the arrested, police identified the accused as MBBS, BAMS and nursing students studying in colleges in Bihar, Delhi and Odisha.

india5.title: Is Telegram working after re-NEET? App restored on Playstore, not on Apple's Appstore yet
india5.description: The government on June 16 directed Telegram and its associated URLs to be blocked across India till June 22 ahead of the June 21 NEET-UG re-exam.

india5.title: Building sealed, FIR registered, 15 dead: What we know and don't about the Lucknow fire
india5.description: The victims were mostly students and young professionals associated with an animation training centre and gaming zone located inside the building.

india5.title: CISF seeks govt nod to set up facial recognition cameras at four airports
india5.description: CISF seeks permission to install facial recognition cameras at Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, and Kolkata airports to identify fugitives using a national database.

india5.title: Collegium recommendation review will open ‘pandora’s box’: SC
india5.description: The Supreme Court denied a judge's petition for reconsideration of his elevation, citing concerns it could set a troubling precedent.

india5.title: Two former CEOs of Reliance ADAG companies arrested by CBI
india5.description: CBI arrests two former Reliance ADAG CEOs for corruption, causing ₹7,623 crore losses to banks through improper loan approvals.

india5.title: Madras HC seeks reports from TN, Puducherry on curbing stray dogs
india5.description: Madras High Court orders Tamil Nadu and Puducherry to report on stray dog management efforts in response to rising public safety concerns.

india5.title: Monsoon inches forward after stalling, set to hit Mumbai in next 48 hours
india5.description: The revival of the monsoon, which had stalled last week, was accompanied by conditions favourable for further, albeit gradual, progress along the west coast.

india5.title: West Bengal budget: 100Kjobs, DA hike, doles
india5.description: West Bengal's BJP government unveiled a ₹4.39 lakh crore budget with 100,000 jobs, women’s doles, new districts, and a focus on infrastructure and welfare.

india6.title: How everyday Kerala is being reimagined in an award-nominated illustration series
india6.description: lllustrator Mohammed Sajid’s portrait series is in contention at the AOI World Illustration Awards 2026, spotlighting fish sellers, flower vendors, postmen and other familiar faces of Kerala’s streets

india6.title: Operation Toofan: Law will apply equally to film personalities and VIPs in drug cases, says Ramesh Chennithala
CAG criticises Kerala govt for ‘irregular’ withdrawals from treasury savings bank accounts
india6.description: CAG report on State Finances for 2024-25 tabled in Kerala Assembly describes certain resumptions of funds as ‘serious breach of accountability and financial propriety’

india6.title: Wang Yi calls for India, China to accelerate resumption of stalled dialogue mechanisms
india6.description: A lengthier Chinese readout of the talks between NSA Ajit Doval and China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi said that the Chinese leader noted that “India is an important neighbour of China”

india6.title: West Bengal government rolls out benefits to 28 lakh women under Annapurna Yojana
india6.description: West Bengal Chief Secretary Manoj Agarwal said that the beneficiaries of Annapurna Yojana will be made public and people will have opportunity to file objections in any non deserving beneficiary is receiving benefit.

india6.title: CJP announces ‘diaper donation drive,’ alleges police attempt to shrink protest site
india6.description: The CJP appealed to their supporters to bring diapers to the protest site, write their demand for Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation on them and participate in the campaign, Diaper A Day Keeps Leaks Away

india6.title: Plea claims ration linked to SIR in West Bengal, SC asks petitioner to move HC
india6.description: A plea in the Supreme Court claims the outcome of the SIR has been linked to the working of the PDS and Annapurna Yojana.

india6.title: What is ammonia poisoning? | Explained
india6.description: Seven people died and many were hospitalised after an ammonia gas leak at a seafood processing plant in Tiruvallur

india6.title: ​Deadly fumes: On the ammonia gas leak tragedy in Tamil Nadu
india6.description: Strict enforcement of safety norms is absent in many industrial units

india6.title: Ayodhya Ram temple donation case: SIT submits preliminary report to U.P. government
india6.description: The Uttar Pradesh government had on June 13 constituted the SIT on a request from the temple trust, following allegations of misappropriation of donations received at the Ayodhya Ram temple

india6.title: Ram temple probe: SIT asks trust and temple functionaries not to leave Ayodhya
india6.description: The instruction by the three-member Special Investigation Team (SIT) was issued before they left for Lucknow on June 21

india6.title: George Kurian resigns as Union Minister, likely to return to Kerala politics
india6.description: Union Minister of State for Minority Affairs Mr. Kurian has resigned from the council of ministers after his Rajya Sabha term came to an end

india6.title: Union Minister George Kurian urges youth to become job creators
Southwest monsoon covers entire Telangana on June 23 after prolonged pause, but El Nino may weaken seasonal rains
india6.description: IMD Hyderabad Head stresses the need for efficient water management and urged farmers to choose crops that require less irrigation

india6.title: BJP president Nabin flays Punjab govt over law and order, drugs, gangsterism, youth migration
india6.description: The BJP president was on a three-day visit to Punjab ahead of the 2027 Assembly polls

india6.title: Vijay government moves Supreme Court on Thirupparankundram row
india6.description: The High Court’s Division Bench had earlier confirmed a previous Single Judge Bench order directing the Subramaniya Swamy Temple management to light the Karthigai Deepam at the ‘deepathoon’

india6.title: Opening of Strait of Hormuz welcome move: NSA Doval at BRICS conclave
Monsoon tracker LIVE: Heavy overnight rain, flooding disrupts life in Western part of Hyderabad
india6.description: The IMD has issued an Orange alert for Mumbai, expecting thunderstorms, lightning, and rainfall

india6.title: TVK, DMK engage in heated debate in Tamil Nadu Assembly over CM Vijay’s remarks on ‘party funds’
india6.description: While the Chief Minister was speaking, DMK MLAs staged a walkout

india6.title: FCRA Rules tightened: NGOs must declare social media accounts, stick to specified activities; political content barred
india6.description: All NGOs and associations registered under FCRA, 2010 are required to disclose specific activities and geographical scope of their programmes

india6.title: Buoyed by ‘improved security’, displaced Pandits converge on Kashmir temple in their thousands
india6.description: Devotees said Kashmir was free of fear and it was possible to travel even at night

india6.title: Kerala govt plans college incubation centres to foster tech-based MSMEs, says Minister P.K. Kunhalikutty
india6.description: Industries and IT Minister says preliminary discussions have already been with Higher Education Minister to formulate policies aimed at strengthening academic-industry collaboration

india6.title: PG owner beaten to death at Kasturinagar in Bengaluru, two students arrested
india6.description: The victim had objected to the duo washing their legs using tap water inside the PG premises

india6.title: Bengaluru to host BRICS heads of space agencies meet on June 23-24
india6.description: Heads and senior representatives of the space agencies of the 11 BRICS member countries will attend the meeting

india6.title: Kerala’s domestic power generation meets only 17% of demand; State facing 900 MW deficit: Electricity Minister
india6.description: Sunny Joseph says despite recording substantial growth in electricity generation capacity in the last decade, Kerala continues to rely heavily on power procured from outside State to meet its rising requirements

india6.title: Jaishankar meets Mongolian leaders, reviews bilateral cooperation
india6.description: Jaishankar said the India-Mongolia relationship is rooted in "deep civilisational and spiritual heritage, shared democratic values, strong development aspirations and strong people-to-people ties".

india6.title: Malayali filmmaker Kunjila Mascillamani on entering the TIFF Directors’ Lab for ‘Guptam’ and struggles of female indie filmmakers
india6.description: Guptam was among the 16 films selected for the TIFF Director’s Lab, and is backed by filmmakers Payal Kapadia, Jeo Baby and actor Kani Kusruti

india6.title: Two workers killed in blast at Dakshin Energy unit in Parawada near Visakhapatnam’s Pharma City
india6.description: Both men were the only workers on the night shift at the Parawada unit, near Pharma City; the Factories department will probe the cause

india6.title: Industry leaders hail West Bengal Budget’s push on infrastructure, land reform and health
india6.description: Representatives of CII, ASSOCHAM and MCC welcomed the provisions highlighted in the first budget tabled by the Bharatiya Janata Party government in West Bengal.

india6.title: IMD forecasts light to moderate rain in Hyderabad on June 23
india6.description: Rain in Hyderabad could be accompanied by gusty winds. Roads and low-lying areas at a few locations may be waterlogged.

india7.title: Union Minister George Kurian resigns
india7.description: Union Minister of State George Kurian has resigned, his Rajya Sabha term having ended and the BJP not renominating him. President Murmu accepted the resignation.

india7.title: Lucknow fire: Toll rises to 15; four building owners arrested
india7.description: Four officials were suspended and four individuals arrested following a Lucknow fire that killed fifteen people; the building was allegedly used illegally for commercial purposes.

india7.title: Centre tightens FCRA rules; NGOs must specify purpose, exclude proselytisation
india7.description: New FCRA rules mandate NGOs list specific purposes and operational areas for foreign funds. Proselytisation is excluded from some religious activities, and key functionaries cannot be foreign nationals, with exceptions possible.

india7.title: 12 students killed as massive blaze engulfs coaching centre in Lucknow
india7.description: Twelve students died in a Lucknow coaching centre fire. Several others are feared trapped as rescue efforts continue, with some students seen jumping to escape.

india7.title: Starmer quits: UK faces seventh PM in tumultuous decade
india7.description: Keir Starmer resigned, making him the UK's seventh leader in ten years, a decade of political upheaval stemming from the Brexit referendum, marked by economic struggles and cabinet resignations.

india7.title: 54 injured, 18 missing after explosion at Qatar LNG site: Authorities
india7.description: An explosion at Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG site injured 54, with 18 missing. QatarEnergy stated a 'technical accident' caused the fire at the Barzan facility, now under control with no public safety threat.

india7.title: El Nino worries: The unfinished agenda of water security
india7.description: A weak monsoon threatens Indian agriculture, impacting farm incomes. While food reserves are adequate, water security remains a gamble due to insufficient irrigation, inefficient usage, silted reservoirs, and neglected water systems.

india7.title: Iran keeps Hormuz closed despite Trump warning on 'Lebanon proxies', Swiss talks enter Day 2
india7.description: Iran-US peace talks in Switzerland continued after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz again, with threats of renewed US attacks. Negotiations are focused on extending a ceasefire and implementing an MOU.

india7.title: CBSE announces first phase of class 12 re-evaluation results
india7.description: CBSE announced Class 12 re-evaluation results, with over 87% of applications processed in the first phase, reassuring students of a transparent system.

india7.title: US, Iran begin peace talks in Switzerland amid Strait of Hormuz row
india7.description: US and Iran began peace talks in Switzerland, aiming to advance an interim deal. Iran's claim of closing the Strait of Hormuz was disputed by the US, and fighting in Lebanon persisted.

japan1.description: KDDIは、取引先の企業に提供しているメールシステムが外部からの不正アクセスを受け、利用者のメールアドレスとパスワードが最大で1422万件、外部に流出した可能性があると発表しました。このシステムは、▽STNet、▽KDDIウェブコミュニケーションズ、▽JCOM、▽中部テレコミュニケーション、▽ニフティ、▽ビッグローブの6社に提供されていて、何者かがメールアドレスとパスワードを不正に取得しているおそれがあるとして、それぞれのサービスの利用者に対し、早急にパスワードの変更を行うよう呼びかけています。

japan1.title: 株価 2500円超下落で7万円割れ 利益確保の売り膨らむ
japan1.description: 23日の東京株式市場、このところの株価の急ピッチな上昇を警戒していったん利益を確定させようという売り注文が膨らみ、日経平均株価は2500円を超える大幅な下落となり、7万円を割り込みました。

japan1.title: 東京23区中古マンション 平均1億2800万円余 賃貸の家賃も上昇
japan1.description: 先月、東京23区で販売された中古マンションの平均価格は、70平方メートルに換算して1億2800万円あまりとなり、去年の同じ月と比べておよそ27％上昇しました。日銀が今月、利上げに踏み切ったことで、住宅需要にどのような影響が出るかが焦点です。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 6月23日(火)】ゴミ袋 素材に新たな手法
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 片山財務相 為替市場“断固たる措置 日米合意揺るぎない”
japan1.description: 外国為替市場で39年半ぶりの円安水準が迫る中、片山財務大臣は、アメリカのベッセント財務長官と22日夜、為替の動向などをテーマにオンラインで会談したことを記者団の取材に明らかにし、「日米間で必要とあれば、断固たる措置を取るという合意に揺るぎはない」と述べました。

japan1.title: 米FRB グリーンスパン元議長が死去 危機対応で名指揮者の異名
japan1.description: アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会の議長をおよそ18年半にわたって務め、金融危機への対応などで「マエストロ＝名指揮者」と言われたアラン・グリーンスパン氏が亡くなりました。100歳でした。

japan1.title: 中国で「サプライチェーン博覧会」始まる 日本企業も出展
japan1.description: 中国の北京でサプライチェーンをテーマにした博覧会が始まり、出展している日本企業からは、日中関係悪化の影響を懸念する声や、製造業の競争力が高い中国で事業を続けていくことが重要だなどといった声が聞かれました。

japan1.title: 株式で従業員に報酬 上場企業の6割が導入 人材定着がねらいか
japan1.description: 従業員に現金とは別に自社の株式を報酬として付与する動きが企業の間で広がっています。制度を導入した企業は上場企業のおよそ6割にのぼっていて、株価の上昇傾向が続く中、人材の定着につなげようというねらいがあるとみられます。

japan1.title: “フィジカルAI” 自動車生産に活用 メーカーの研究開発が加速
japan1.description: 人工知能が周囲の状況を自律的に判断してロボットなどを動かす「フィジカルAI」。自動車メーカーの間では工場での車両生産に活用しようと研究開発が加速しています。

japan1.title: 円相場 約39年半ぶりの円安水準に迫る 市場介入の警戒も
japan1.description: 22日のニューヨーク外国為替市場では、アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会による利上げ観測などを背景に円売りドル買いの動きが進み、円相場は一時、1ドル＝161円90銭台まで値下がりし、およそ39年半ぶりの円安水準に迫りました。その後は政府・日銀による市場介入への警戒感などから急激に円を買い戻す動きも出て、荒い値動きとなっています。

japan1.title: 片山財務相 米ベッセント財務長官と会談 為替動向を意見交換か
japan1.description: 片山財務大臣が22日夜、アメリカのベッセント財務長官とオンラインで会談を行ったことが分かりました。外国為替市場で39年半ぶりとなる円安ドル高水準が迫る中、為替の動向について意見を交わした可能性があります。

japan1.title: 日本ハム ウインナーやハムなど約220品目 8月分から値上げへ
japan1.description: 食品メーカー大手の「日本ハム」は、原材料費や人件費が上昇していることなどから、家庭用や業務用のウインナーやハムなどおよそ220品目をことし8月の納品分から値上げしたり、内容量を変更したりすると発表しました。

japan1.title: リニア 静岡県住民説明会が終了 知事が着工いつ認めるか焦点
japan1.description: リニア中央新幹線の静岡県内での着工に向けて、JR東海が行ってきた住民説明会が22日で終わりました。今後は静岡県の鈴木知事が着工をいつ認めるかが焦点となります。

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝161円台後半に 米利上げ観測広がり
japan1.description: 22日の東京外国為替市場、アメリカで利上げ観測が高まり、日本との金利差の広がりが意識されたことから、円を売ってドルを買う動きが進んで、円相場は1ドル＝161円台後半まで値下がりしました。

japan1.title: 北陸新幹線 JR西社長「小浜・京都ルート」支持 国の試算受け
japan1.description: 北陸新幹線の新大阪への延伸をめぐり、国が8つのルートの費用対効果の試算を示したことについて、JR西日本の倉坂昇治社長は、「小浜・京都ルート」が望ましいとする考えを改めて示しました。

japan1.title: 株価 終値初の7万2000円超 6営業日連続で終値として最高値更新
japan1.description: 週明けの22日の東京株式市場、イラン情勢をめぐる協議で進展があったという見方から、日経平均株価は初めて7万2000円を超え、6営業日連続で終値として最高値を更新しました。

japan1.title: 「紅プリンセス」苗木が中国で販売か 農相“愛媛県を支援”
japan1.description: 愛媛県が開発した高級かんきつ「紅プリンセス」と似た名前の苗木が中国で販売されていることについて、鈴木農林水産大臣は「日本産の農産物の海外流出は深刻な問題だ」としたうえで、県に対して必要な支援を行う考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 塗料用シンナー直接販売する仕組み整備 23日から注文受け付け
japan1.description: 塗料用シンナーの流通の目詰まりを解消するとして、経済産業省はメーカーから工務店などに直接販売する仕組みを整備しました。23日から注文の受け付けを始めるのを前に製品が倉庫に搬入されました。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 6月22日(月)】国際援助で農作物確保へ
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: “書店の減少に歯止めを” 15社が収益改善に向け共同声明
japan1.description: 書店の数が減少する中、各地で書店を展開する15社は、共同で物流の効率化などを進め、収益の改善に取り組むとする声明を発表しました。直接、出版社から本を仕入れるなどして利益の改善につなげ、書店の減少に歯止めをかけたい考えです。

japan1.title: メガバンク3行 ステーブルコイン 今年度中に共同発行へ
japan1.description: 円などの法定通貨を裏付けとしたステーブルコインについて、メガバンク3行が今年度中に共同での発行を目指すことになりました。株式などを購入する際の決済手段としての活用を検討していて、利用のすそ野が広がるかが焦点となります。

japan1.title: 東電の提携交渉 日米の投資ファンドや通信大手の5陣営が軸に
japan1.description: 経営の抜本的な改善に向けて広く提携先を募ってきた、東京電力ホールディングスは、提案内容を精査した結果、日米の投資ファンドや通信大手のあわせて5つの陣営を軸に交渉を進めていく方針を固めました。5つの陣営は、大がかりな事業再編に向けて今後、会社の資産査定などを本格化させることになります。

japan1.title: NISA対象と偽って不適切販売 外資系ネット証券に行政処分
japan1.description: 個人投資家を対象にした「NISA」の普及が進む中、制度の対象になっていない金融商品を対象のように偽って販売していたなどとして、関東財務局は19日、外資系ネット証券の「moomoo証券」に対して、新規口座の開設の勧誘など一部の業務を停止する命令を出しました。

japan1.title: JBIC新総裁に天川和彦氏就任 “対米投資サポートする”
japan1.description: JBIC＝国際協力銀行の天川和彦新総裁が19日、就任会見を開き、日米合意にもとづく対米投資について「これまでに経験したものとは違う特殊なプロジェクトだが、JBICならではの知識を使ってサポートしていきたい」と述べました。

japan1.title: 日清食品 カップ焼きそば28万食余を自主回収
japan1.description: 大手食品メーカーの「日清食品」は、カップ焼きそばに合成樹脂片が混入しているおそれがあるとして、28万食余りを自主回収すると発表しました。

japan1.title: ロッテ アイスの値上げ発表 カルテル疑いで立ち入り検査後
japan1.description: 大手菓子メーカーのロッテは、原材料価格などの上昇を受けて、7月以降に出荷するアイスクリームを値上げすると発表しました。ロッテを含む大手メーカー6社は、アイスの価格を引き上げるカルテルを結んでいた疑いがあるとして公正取引委員会から立ち入り検査を受けています。

japan1.title: 日銀植田総裁が19日退院 来週23日から公務に
japan1.description: 日銀は、感染症の治療のため入院していた植田総裁が19日に退院したと発表しました。来週23日から公務にあたるということです。

japan1.title: セブン-イレブン 加盟店負担軽減の新契約 半世紀ぶりの見直し
japan1.description: コンビニ最大手のセブン-イレブン・ジャパンは店舗オーナーのなり手不足が課題となる中、ブランドの使用料などとして店舗が支払う費用の負担を軽減するなどした新たな契約体系を導入すると発表しました。全面的な見直しはおよそ50年ぶりで、店舗網の拡大を図るねらいです。

japan1.description: 19日の東京外国為替市場、アメリカで利上げ観測が強まり、日本との金利差の広がりが意識されたことから円を売ってドルを買う動きが多く、1ドル＝161円台での取り引きが続きました。

aus1.title: Suspended Qld police officer facing an array of charges granted bail
aus1.description: A suspended Queensland police officer arrested over alleged offences against multiple women has been granted bail.

aus1.title: Court told alleged cult leader groomed girl to have 45 of his children
aus1.description: William "Little Pebble" Kamm has denied allegations he groomed a girl for more than a decade after he was accused of declaring in phone calls that it was her "mission" to become his queen.

aus1.title: Family feels 'defeated' as mining company fined over worker's death
aus1.description: Family members of Gavin Feltwell, who died on site at a central Queensland mine, say he was "incredibly safety conscious" as the company is fined $310,000.

aus1.title: Kids Helpline crisis interventions on the rise again towards COVID high
aus1.description: Kids Helpline says a growing number of Australian young people are requiring immediate emergency help, with a concerning trend around crisis interventions.

aus1.title: Two dead in car crash in Tasmania's south
aus1.description: Two vehicles collided at Old Beach in Tasmania's south earlier today. The two occupants of one of the vehicles have died at the scene, while the other driver is uninjured.

aus1.title: Senior Albanese minister clashes with Pocock over top-secret AI copyright claim
aus1.description: Federal politician David Pocock has clashed with a senior Albanese government minister over a whistleblower claim that federal cabinet is considering plans to let AI companies train on Australian copyright material.

aus1.title: Angus Taylor refuses to commit to a multicultural Australia
aus1.description: The opposition leader, pressed multiple times on whether his party still supported multiculturalism or endorsed One Nation leader Pauline Hanson's vision of a "monoculture", refused to commit to either.

aus1.title: NT opposition leader defends office culture amid workplace misconduct claims
aus1.description: Northern Territory Opposition Leader Selena Uibo has defended her handling of workplace misconduct allegations in her office, saying it is a "highly-charged political environment that is unique and unlike most workplaces".

aus1.title: Jail for man who sexually assaulted 76-year-old in aged care home
aus1.description: A 76-year-old woman was left "crying buckets" after being sexually assaulted in a Mid North Coast aged care home, a court hears. Her attacker has now been jailed for 12 years.

aus1.title: Video of nurse allegedly threatening Israelis excluded from court case
aus1.description: Lawyers argued the viral video clip from an online chat with an Israeli influencer breached NSW laws prohibiting recording private conversations without consent.

aus1.title: 'Shaman' lied about magic mushrooms before Adelaide fashion icon's death, inquest hears
aus1.description: A coronial inquest is investigating the death of Adelaide fashion icon Carol Foord, who used magic mushrooms as an alternative treatment prior to her death in June 2024.

aus1.title: New Mariners owner snubs women's side, coach told services not needed
aus1.description: A new owner has been confirmed for struggling A-League club the Central Coast Mariners, but it has only bought the men's team and the club's academy, leaving the future of the women's team in doubt.

aus1.title: Alessandro Circati chose Australia over Italy. His dad approves
aus1.description: Alessandro Circati's decision to play for the Socceroos raised eyebrows within his family in Italy, but his father says they now realise that, deep down, he's not Italian.

aus1.title: Man fined for selling 19 tonnes of horse meat to greyhound trainers
aus1.description: A Wagga Wagga man will be more than $40,000 out of pocket after selling tonnes of horse meat to dog trainers in NSW and Victoria.

aus1.title: SA pushes for AI data centres as industry says it's not asking for subsidies
aus1.description: The South Australian government is pushing for the state to become home to billions of dollars' worth of artificial intelligence data centres, but says it will seek to regulate their water and energy use.

aus1.title: Poultry producers warn bird flu would be 'catastrophic for Tasmania'
aus1.description: Tasmanian poultry producers are ramping up biosecurity measures, as they prepare for the arrival of a deadly strain of bird flu. The state government has stressed that it's well prepared, but says euthanasia is "definitely possible" if there's an outbreak in commercial poultry.

aus1.title: Chihuahua Jet takes to the air as more pets allowed in cabin
aus1.description: An Australian airline is allowing small cats and dogs on a range of flights, with other passengers appearing unconcerned about sharing the plane with furry creatures.

aus1.title: Students protest AI amid growing national concerns
aus1.description: As Australia tracks toward becoming a global leader in artificial intelligence infrastructure, a group of high school students is demanding stronger regulation.

aus1.title: 'Ridiculous and disrespectful' inquiry into NDIS cuts extended
aus1.description: Disability advocates welcome an extension to a Senate inquiry probing a bill paving the way for the biggest-ever cuts to the NDIS.

aus1.title: Dead birds to be tested for H5N1 bird flu after washing up on SA coast
aus1.description: Two dead seabirds have been collected and are being tested for the H5N1 bird flu virus in South Australia, as well as another two wild birds in Western Australia, following Australia's first confirmed cases of the deadly variant this week.

aus1.title: Renewable energy company admits 'failures' caused destruction of Aboriginal site
aus1.description: ACEREZ introduces strict cultural heritage protocols after a rock shelter was irreparably damaged.

aus1.title: Church youth leader sentenced for sexually assaulting 13-year-old
aus1.description: A man who assaulted a girl in his car has dodged a lengthy jail term, with a judge saying there were "exceptional circumstances" that warranted a discounted sentence.

aus1.title: The winners and losers in Queensland's state budget
aus1.description: The Queensland treasurer has handed down the state budget. Take a look at what it includes and who benefits.

aus1.title: Executive public service roles capped and back-to-school payments in Qld budget
aus1.description: The Queensland government has handed down its 2026/27 state budget, its second since assuming government in 2024.

aus1.title: Newly discovered spider uses 'ballista' web to capture prey
aus1.description: A bizarre species of spider from the rainforests of Far North Queensland springs a nasty surprise.

bang3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bang3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bang3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bang3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bang3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bang3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
